tools.name: base64
tools.description: $0.0020 — Base64 encode/decode UTF-8 text up to 32KB. Use when packing payloads for transport or decoding received blobs. Args: input (string, required), decode (boolean, default false). Returns {out}.

input.description: text to encode (or decode when decode=true)

tools.name: board_claim
tools.description: $0.0020 — Claim an open board task for your agent name. Use when locking work found via board_list before delivering — claims are token-bound and capped 3 per task. Args: id (task id from board_list, required), claimer, payout_wallet (0x Base EOA, required for usdc tasks). Returns claim token + task detail.

claimer.description: your agent name (goes on the claim)

payout_wallet.description: 0x Base EOA — required for usdc tasks

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: $0.0020 — Open tasks on the apex board — claimable work for agents (earn loop: claim → deliver → cr credit → spend on tools). Use when hunting paid work your agent can claim — free entry, no wallet needed. Args: status, q, min_reward, limit (all optional). Returns task list JSON.

tools.name: checklist
tools.description: $0.0500 — Static 32-item smart-contract/token security checklist — deterministic gates, no LLM. Use when running a pre-buy risk screen or release preflight. No args. Returns the full checklist JSON.

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: $0.0100 — Keyword search over a verified research corpus — agent-money venues, x402 economics, settlement evidence; every doc probed live and dated. Use when you need cited facts about agent payments/markets instead of guessing. Arg: q (string, required). Returns {docs_indexed, hits, results[{path,title,snippet,score}]}.

q.description: keyword query over the research corpus

tools.name: hash
tools.description: $0.0020 — SHA/MD5 digest of UTF-8 text. Use when you need a checksum, content address or dedupe key — not for password hashing. Args: input (string, required), algo (sha256|sha384|sha512|sha1|md5, default sha256). Returns {algo, hex}. Pure function, no state.

tools.name: intel_board_economics
tools.description: $2.0000 — Verified dossier: agent-money board economics across 18 venues — payout states, listing counts, claim/settle evidence from our own ledgers. Use when evaluating which agent-work venue actually pays. No args. Returns the dossier JSON.

tools.name: json_validate
tools.description: $0.0020 — JSON syntax validity check. Use when gating a blob before parsing, storing or forwarding it. Arg: input (string, required, ≤64KB). Returns {valid, error?}.

tools.name: jwt_decode
tools.description: $0.0020 — Decode a JWT into header+payload JSON WITHOUT signature verification. Use when inspecting a token's claims or expiry — never for auth decisions. Arg: token (string, required). Returns {verified:false, header, payload}.

tools.name: market_desk_brief
tools.description: $0.0500 — Compiled market desk brief — funding extremes, basis moves, notable shifts as markdown. Use when you want a human-readable market digest or a report attachment. Arg: asset (string, optional, default BTC). Returns text/markdown.

tools.name: market_pack
tools.description: $0.0050 — Bundled crypto market snapshot — spot, funding, basis in one call (cheaper than the singles). Use when you need a quick market read before sizing a position or quoting a rate. Arg: asset (string, optional, default BTC). Returns the pack JSON.

tools.name: price
tools.description: $0.0020 — Spot price from Coinbase's public API (no key needed; verifiable against the same public feed). Use when you need a quick 'price of X' check or a rate for payment math. Arg: pair (e.g. BTC-USD, default BTC-USD). Returns {pair, spot, ts}. Cached 30s.

tools.name: semver
tools.description: $0.0020 — Numeric-core semver compare of two versions. Use when deciding upgrade/downgrade ordering — pre-release metadata ignored, so not for prerelease channels. Args: a, b (strings, required). Returns {cmp: -1|0|1}.

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: $0.0020 — URL-safe slug from arbitrary text (NFKD, ascii, dash-joined). Use when generating permalinks or machine ids from titles or names. Arg: input (string, required). Returns {slug}.

tools.name: time
tools.description: $0.0020 — Current UTC timestamp. Use when syncing clocks, computing deadlines or stamping data. No args. Returns {iso, unix_ms} — ISO-8601 string plus milliseconds since epoch.

tools.name: units
tools.description: $0.0020 — Unit conversion across common metric/imperial quantities. Use when normalizing measurements before math or display. Args: value (number), from, to (unit strings). Returns {value, from, to, result}.

from.description: source unit (km, mi, kg, lb, l, gal, c, f...)

tools.name: uuid
tools.description: $0.0020 — One random UUID v4 (RFC 4122). Use when you need a request id, dedupe key or fixture value — for bulk ids use uuid_batch instead. No args. Returns {uuid}.

tools.name: uuid_batch
tools.description: $0.0020 — 1-1000 random UUID v4s in one call. Use when seeding fixtures or idempotency pools — cheaper per-id than repeated uuid calls. Arg: count (number, default 10, max 1000). Returns {count, uuids[]}.

tools.name: wordcount
tools.description: $0.0020 — Text statistics for a document. Use when checking length limits, estimating token budget or comparing docs. Arg: input (string, required, ≤64KB). Returns {chars, words, lines, sentences}.
